name: 2x4x8 plate stock
notes: Board 1: continuous sole plate at full length 2438.4 mm (no cut). Board 2: top plate at full length 2438.4 mm (no cut). The doorway section is removed from the anchored sole plate, not pre-cut.

name: 2x4x8 stud stock
notes: 6 boards: one per full-height stud (2362.2 mm + 3 mm kerf = 2365.2 <= 2438.4). 2 boards: one per jack stud (2032 mm) whose offcut also yields one cripple (190.5 mm): 2032 + 190.5 + 2 x 3 mm kerf = 2228.5 <= 2438.4. Kerf convention: one 3 mm kerf per claimed cut.

name: 2x6x8 header stock
notes: One board yields both header plies: 2 x 1104.9 + 2 x 3 mm kerf = 2215.8 <= 2438.4 mm.

name: 1/2 in plywood header spacer
notes: 1104.9 mm strip cut from 1/2 in plywood offcut (no board yield claimed); fills the 2x4 wall thickness between the header plies.

name: 2x4x8 temporary racking brace
notes: One board yields the in-plane racking brace (1336.2 mm + 3 mm kerf = 1339.2 <= 2438.4) and leaves a reusable offcut. It resists racking; it does not hold the wall plumb.

name: 2x4x8 temporary plumb prop
notes: One board yields the out-of-plane plumb prop (2425.9 mm + 3 mm kerf = 2428.9 <= 2438.4 mm).

name: 2x6x8 backing block stock
notes: One board yields both backing blocks: 368.3 + 336.55 + 2 x 3 mm kerf = 710.85 <= 2438.4 mm.

name: Synthetic structural screw 8 x 63 mm (demonstration)
notes: Two screws at every frame joint: 14 plate joints, 2 header joints and 4 cripple ends (20 joints, 40 screws). Synthetic demonstration value only.

name: Synthetic mechanical anchor M10 x 100 mm (demonstration)
notes: Anchors on the permanent plate segments only (152.4, 762 and 2320 mm), 609.6 mm on centre where the plate allows; pilot 10 mm x 60 mm (synthetic). No anchor remains in the door opening.

name: 1/2 in gypsum panel 4x8
notes: Trimmed to the door opening for the demonstration.

name: Backing screw (specification withheld)
notes: Proposed only; the backing connection is held.
